findings.summary: The page opens with English letters and investment jargon, so a non-expert feels at once that it isn't meant for her and may give up.
Red minus amounts and red bars in the account list don't say what they are measured against, so the reader can't tell a real loss from 'less than the top option'.
Small grey text on a dark background, under the numbers and in the legends, stays hard to read even when enlarged.
Too many numbers and coloured labels on one screen make the reader anxious.
The top choice is an unfamiliar provider (פסגות) and the page doesn't clearly explain why the big banks rank lower.
The 7% return is filled in by default, and nothing says that returns can also go down.
Legend colours on screens 2 and 5 are too close together to tell the series apart.
Nothing shows who runs the site, so the reader has no reason to trust it.
